title: Love Left Unspoken
content:
The room fell silent.

Sneha stood there for a few moments, staring at Siddu in disbelief.

Only then did she notice the earbuds resting in his ears.

Her shoulders slowly dropped.

"So..."

"He didn't hear anything."

A helpless smile appeared on her face.

All the courage she had gathered...

All the emotions she had poured into her confession...

Had gone unheard.

For a moment, disappointment filled her heart.

Then it slowly turned into annoyance.

She walked straight toward Siddu.

Without warning, she gently pulled one of his earbuds out.

Siddu immediately opened his eyes in surprise.

"Huh?"

"Sneha?"

"What happened?"

Sneha folded her arms and looked at him with an irritated expression.

"You always get lost in your own little musical world."

"Come back to the real world once in a while."

"I was trying to tell you something important..."

"And you're sitting here peacefully listening to songs."

Siddu blinked in confusion.

He had no idea why she was suddenly so upset.

Before he could say anything, Sneha herself realized how naturally she had scolded him.

The way she had spoken...

It wasn't like an ordinary friend.

It sounded as though she already had a special place in his life.

Her cheeks instantly turned pink.

Siddu tilted his head.

"What happened, Sneha?"

"Why are you so angry?"

"And what was this important thing you wanted to tell me?"

Sneha froze.

For nearly a minute...

Neither of them spoke.

Siddu waved his hand in front of her face.

"Hello, madam..."

"Are you alright?"

She suddenly came back to her senses.

"Y-Yes, sir."

Both of them laughed awkwardly.

The tension between them slowly faded.

Still curious, Siddu asked again,

"So..."

"What was it that you wanted to tell me?"

Sneha looked into his eyes.

The words almost escaped her lips.

"I..."

"I lo..."

She stopped herself.

"Not yet..."

"It's too soon."

She stopped herself.

After a brief pause, a playful smile appeared on her face.

"You'll know it soon."

Siddu frowned.

"Now you've made me even more curious."

Sneha simply smiled and refused to answer.

Unable to get anything out of her, Siddu shook his head with a laugh and finished his dinner.

After cleaning up, Sneha walked toward the bed.

"Aren't you going to sleep?" she asked.

Siddu picked up his phone.

"Not yet."

"I'll watch some anime for a while."

"Okay," Sneha replied softly.

Within a few minutes, she drifted off to sleep.

________________________________________

The night grew quieter.

Outside, the cool breeze of Jammu gently brushed against the windows.

Around two o'clock in the morning...

Sneha slowly opened her eyes.

Half asleep, she instinctively looked toward Siddu's bed.

It was empty.

Her sleep disappeared instantly.

"Siddu...?"

She quietly got up and stepped into the living area.

There...

She found him sleeping peacefully on the sofa.

His phone lay beside him, still showing the paused anime he had been watching.

A small blanket had slipped halfway to the floor.

Sneha couldn't help but smile.

"So this is where you ended up..."

She slowly walked closer.

Looking at his peaceful face, her heart melted.

"Such a wonderful person..."

she whispered.

Carefully, so she wouldn't wake him, she bent down and gently kissed his cheek.

A soft smile appeared on her lips.

"Good night, Siddu..."

Without making the slightest sound, she quietly returned to her bed.

Within moments...

She was asleep once again.

Completely unaware...

That somewhere between shared smiles, quiet conversations, and countless little moments...

Sneha had already fallen in love with him.
